name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-graph-flow-engine
description: Use when you want flow semantics on top of the DAG kernel: it compiles FlowDefinitions into kernel graphs (schema-validated node configs, explicit input mappings, a per-run blackboard), provides the FlowEngine service (registerFlow/unregisterFlow/run/RunHandle/listRuns), the node-type registry with noop/fail/echo starter handlers and a subflow type, node-level retry/timeout/onError policies and mocks; skip it when you only need the neutral kernel (@deepseek-ai/dsh-graph-core) or type-only declarations (@deepseek-ai/dsh-graph-flow-api).
